_about: Seconds per action at pro pace, for pricing plans. Every entry has a source and a tag: wiki (game mechanic), run (the human run's own segment times), agent (measured by the rmalde agent harness), estimate (no source; needs a human check, listed in UNVERIFIED.md). Report results as seconds vs the priced reference plan and check they survive +-30% on 'estimate' entries.

travel.source: https://minecraft.wiki/w/Sprinting (raw line 33: sprint-jumping averages 7.127 m/s; 1/7.127 = 0.1403 s per block)
travel.notes: Straight-line horizontal distance, same speed in every dimension. Assumes runners sprint-jump on open ground (estimate). Plain sprinting is 5.612 m/s = 0.1782 s/block.

enter_portal_nether.source: https://minecraft.wiki/w/Nether_Portal (raw line 35: 80 game ticks in Survival)
enter_portal_nether.notes: Loading time is not counted in IGT.

enter_portal_end.source: estimate: End portals teleport on contact; not checked on the wiki

loot_chest.source: estimate: open, shift-click the stack(s), close

craft.source: rmalde/minecraft-agent:optimization/nether/REVIEW.md:25 (flint-and-steel crafting took 1.187 s including screen acknowledgement)
craft.notes: A bot measurement; a human is similar or slower. Applies per craft action, not per item.

mine_obsidian_diamond.source: https://minecraft.wiki/w/Obsidian (History: breaking time 9.4 s with a diamond pickaxe since Beta 1.9 RC1)

mine_gravel.source: estimate: gravel by hand (hardness 0.6); a shovel is faster. Check the wiki breaking table.

build_portal_chest_obsidian.source: estimate: 10 placements x place_block + 1 s positioning

build_portal_complete_ruined.source: estimate: 7 placements x place_block + 1 s positioning (7 from rmalde/minecraft-agent:optimization/nether/REVIEW.md:9)

build_portal_bucket_lava.source: estimate: mold + water casting of 10 frame blocks; needs a VOD-timed example

build_portal_mine_obsidian.source: 10 x mine_obsidian_diamond (9.4 s) + 10 x place_block; mining time from https://minecraft.wiki/w/Obsidian

barter.source: https://minecraft.wiki/w/Bartering (piglin examines the ingot for 6 s / 120 ticks)
barter.notes: Runners barter several piglins in parallel; price one barter action as 6 s plus 0.5 s per ingot thrown (estimate).

throw_eye.source: https://minecraft.wiki/w/Eye_of_Ender (raw line 32: two or three seconds of travel)

end_fight_beds.source: https://www.speedrun.com/api/v1/runs/yoex3d0z (comment: End portal exit to pause 7.733 s + resume to finish 51.500 s)
end_fight_beds.notes: Whole End segment of the human run: waiting for the perch, bed explosions, entering the exit portal. Price a bed kill (bed_explode reaching rules.dragon_beds_required, then enter_portal) as this fixed cost.

kill_ender_dragon_melee.source: estimate: several perches of melee. The agent's End stage with beds was 152 s (rmalde/minecraft-agent:README.md:7); melee is slower.

reset.source: Reset ends the plan; scored by choice, not time.

dragon_beds_required.source: rmalde/minecraft-agent:README.md:9 and optimization/nether/REVIEW.md:41,57 (six bed explosions killed the dragon)
dragon_beds_required.notes: What the agent needed in its runs, not a game constant: bed damage depends on distance and hit location. Human bed count needs the VOD.

calibration.notes: A should price reference/T20_full_route_seed.json and compare segment by segment with these. Expect the priced plan to be faster than the human in the overworld because the plan has no camera/menu time.
